title: Cristiano Ronaldo handed instant reunion as new Portugal manager announced | talkSPORT
text:
The 71-year-old has signed a four-year deal through to the end of the 2030 tournament.

Portugal will co-host the next World Cup alongside Spain and Morocco in four years' time.

Jesus will also oversee their upcoming Nations League campaign as well as qualifying for Euro 2028.

His arrival comes after Roberto Martinez departed following Portugal's last 16 defeat to Spain on Monday.

The outgoing manager had already been set to depart at the end of this summer's World Cup.

Martinez had made the decision not to renew his deal, which would have expired at the end of this month.

Jesus will now begin preparing for his first match in charge at home to Wales on September 24.

Portugal will also face Norway and Denmark as part of their Nations League league phase schedule.

Jesus' arrival sees him reunite with Cristiano Ronaldo less than two months after the pair last worked together.

The five-time Ballon d'Or winner is fresh from winning the Saudi Pro League title with Al Nassr under his new national team boss.

Ronaldo scored 30 goals in 37 appearances under Jesus last season.

The veteran forward is yet to announce his international retirement despite turning 42 next February.

Having scored three goals in five appearances this summer, he now has 146 goals in 233 caps for his country.

However, Ronaldo will be 43 at the start of Euro 2028 and 45 before the 2030 World Cup gets underway.

At present, the oldest player in World Cup history is former Egypt goalkeeper Essam El-Hadary at 45 years and 161 days.

Jesus' new role will be his first in international management during a 37-year coaching career.

As well as winning the title with Al Nassr last season, he previously triumphed in Saudi Arabia during his time at Al Hilal.

His trophy cabinet also includes a Brazilian title with Flamengo as well as three league victories in his native Portugal as Benfica boss.

Jesus' previous jobs also include a season-long stint in Turkey managing Fenerbahce.
